import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
import re
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)


def preprocess_text(text):
    """Targeted emoji removal preserving accented characters."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        text = str(text)

    # Convert to lowercase
    text = text.lower()

    # Remove HTML tags and entities
    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\"", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"&", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"<", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r">", "", text)

    # Remove URLs and website patterns
    text = re.sub(r"http\S+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"https\S+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"www\.\S+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"ftp\S+", " ", text)

    # Remove username/mention patterns
    text = re.sub(r"@[\w\d_]+", " ", text)

    # Remove numeric-only strings that might be IDs
    text = re.sub(r"\b\d{3,}\b", " ", text)

    # REMOVE ONLY UNICODE EMOJIS (U+1F600+ ranges for smileys + others)
    # Preserve accented characters like é, ö, ñ for linguistic signal
    text = re.sub(
        r"[\u200D\uFE0F\u20E3]+", " ", text
    )  # Zero-width joiner, variation selectors, etc.

    # Normalize whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()

    return text


def main():
    print("Loading data...")
    train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv", encoding="utf-8")
    test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv", encoding="utf-8")
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv", encoding="utf-8")

    tox_columns = [
        "toxic",
        "severe_toxic",
        "obscene",
        "threat",
        "insult",
        "identity_hate",
    ]

    X_train_raw = train["comment_text"]
    X_test_raw = test["comment_text"]
    y_train = train[tox_columns].values
    test_ids = test["id"].values

    print("Preprocessing text...")

    # Vectorized preprocessing for training data
    def vec_preprocess(text):
        """Vectorized version of preprocess_text for efficiency"""
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str):
            return ""
        text = str(text).lower()
        text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text)
        text = re.sub(r"[\&\;][^a-zA-Z0-9]*", "", text)
        text = re.sub(r"http[s]?://\S+", " ", text)
        text = re.sub(r"www\.\S+", " ", text)
        text = re.sub(r"@\w+\d*[\W\d]*", " ", text)
        text = re.sub(r"\b\d{3,}\b", " ", text)
        text = re.sub(r"[\u200D\uFE0F]+", " ", text)
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
        return text

    X_train_processed = X_train_raw.apply(vec_preprocess)

    # Vectorized preprocessing for test data
    test_df = test.copy()
    test_df["comment_text"] = test_df["comment_text"].apply(vec_preprocess)
    X_test_processed = (
        test_df["comment_text"].apply(lambda x: x if x else "").astype(str)
    )

    # Vectorize text
    print("Vectorizing text...")
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        max_features=40000,
        min_df=1,
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        stop_words="english",
        sublinear_tf=True,
        smooth_idf=False,
        binary=True,
    )
    X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_processed.tolist())
    X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_test_processed.tolist())

    # Split data WITHOUT stratification for stability
    print("Splitting data...")
    X_trn_val, X_val, y_trn_val, y_val = train_test_split(
        X_train_vec, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=False
    )

    if len(y_trn_val) > 0:
        pass
    else:
        raise ValueError("No training samples after split!")

    # Train ONEVSREST CLASSIFIER
    print("Training classifier...")
    ovr_clf = OneVsRestClassifier(
        LogisticRegression(
            class_weight="balanced",
            max_iter=2000,
            C=1.0,
            solver="lbfgs",
            warm_start=False,
            verbose=0,
            n_jobs=-1,
        ),
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    ovr_clf.fit(X_trn_val, y_trn_val)

    # Generate predictions for validation set
    val_preds = ovr_clf.predict_proba(X_val)

    # Compute validation metric correctly - mean of per-class AUCs
    col_roc_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds, average=None)
    mean_val_auc = np.mean(col_roc_auc)

    print(f"\nValidation Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_val_auc:.6f}")
    print(f"Per-Class Validation AUCs: {[f'{auc:.6f}' for auc in col_roc_auc]}")

    # Generate predictions ONLY on TEST SET
    print("Generating predictions for test set...")
    test_probs = ovr_clf.predict_proba(X_test_vec)

    # Create submission file
    print("Creating submission file...")
    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=tox_columns)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test_ids)

    # Save to REQUIRED PATH
    submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

    # Print final metrics
    print("\n=== FINAL EVALUATION METRIC ===")
    print(f"Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_val_auc:.6f}")
    print(f"Column ROC AUCs: {[f'{auc:.6f}' for auc in col_roc_auc]}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
